2. What data we process
**Contact data:** first name, surname, phone, email, language and the channel or time slot you prefer.

**Your search data** (“My search” form): operation (buy or rent), property type, areas, budget, surface area, bedrooms, bathrooms, features, timeframes and, if you tell us, your financing situation or the sale of your current home.
**Your home data** if you request a valuation or want to sell it: address or neighbourhood, type, surface area and condition.
**Your comments** and the data you decide to include in them. Do not include data that is not necessary, such as health data or data about other people.
**Proof of your consents:** the text you accepted, the version of the text and the date.

**Technical data of the visit:** when you open the website, our servers and the external services that are loaded (for example, Google maps) receive your IP address and basic data about your browser. How they work is explained in the [cookie policy](route:cookies).
You give us the data yourself. We do not ask for specially protected data.
3. What we use it for and the legal basis

head: Purpose
Legal basis
How long
rows: Handling your enquiries and contact requests (Contact form, email, WhatsApp or phone).
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) and the application of pre-contractual measures at your request (Art. 6.1.b).
The time needed to attend to you. Afterwards, blocked for as long as legal liabilities may arise.
Valuing your home (valuator and request for an in-person valuation).
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a) and pre-contractual measures at your request (Art. 6.1.b).
The time needed for the valuation and its follow-up. Afterwards, blocked for the time required by law.
Keeping your home search in our database of buyers and tenants (“My search” form), matching it with the available properties, notifying you of those that fit and contacting you.
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a), which you give by ticking the box on the form.
While your search is active and, at most, 12 months from our last contact with you.
Providing the services you hire (brokerage, advice, rental management…) and complying with the associated legal obligations.
Performance of the contract (Art. 6.1.b) and compliance with legal obligations (Art. 6.1.c), for example tax obligations and those of anti-money-laundering.
For as long as the relationship lasts and, afterwards, the periods set by law for each obligation.
Sending you commercial communications about properties, services and news by email, WhatsApp or phone, depending on the channel you choose.
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) and the express authorisation required by Art. 21 of the LSSI. It is voluntary and does not affect your search.
Until you withdraw your consent or unsubscribe.
Sending you the HousySpace newsletter and articles by email.
Your consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) and the express authorisation required by Art. 21 of the LSSI. It is voluntary and independent of the others.
Until you unsubscribe using the link in each mailing or by writing to info@housyspace.com.

items.text: Each consent is independent and you can withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of the previous processing. The boxes for commercial communications and newsletter come unticked, and not ticking them does not affect your search.
4. Who receives your data
We do not disclose your data to third parties, except where legally required (for example, to the tax authorities or to the competent authorities).

If you request a service that requires the involvement of other professionals, such as financial or legal advice, a renovation, a notary or a registry, we will tell you and we will only share your data with them with your knowledge and, where appropriate, your consent.
To provide you with the service, the following providers process data on our behalf and under contract, as processors:
**Cloudflare, Inc.:** website hosting and content delivery network.
**Resend, Inc.:** sending the email notice to our team when you fill in a form.
**Mobilia:** CRM where we manage contacts and searches.
**WhatsApp (Meta Platforms):** messaging, only when you choose that channel.
**Email provider** and, when we activate it, **newsletter sending tool**.

Google (maps) receives your IP address and browser data when those features are loaded; it is an independent company and does not act on our behalf. This is explained in the [cookie policy](route:cookies).

**Online valuator.** The online valuator (“Instant” option of the valuation window) is provided by an external provider, Lystos, and is shown inside our page. The data you enter in it is received by Lystos and processed according to its own privacy information, which we recommend you read; it is not HousySpace's “Request valuation” form. If in the valuator you ask us to contact you, Lystos passes us your contact details and those of the home, and from that moment we process them in accordance with this policy.
5. International transfers

Some of these providers (Cloudflare, Resend, Google, WhatsApp) belong to groups headquartered in the United States or may process data there. Where this is the case, the transfer is covered by the European Commission's adequacy decision for the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, if the provider has joined it, or by the standard contractual clauses approved by the Commission. You can ask us for more information at [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com).
6. Your rights

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw your consents, by writing to [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com) and indicating which right you want to exercise. In order to attend to you properly, we may ask you to prove your identity. We reply within one month.
To unsubscribe from the newsletter or from commercial communications, you can use the unsubscribe link in each email or write to us.

If you believe we are not processing your data in accordance with the law, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency ([www.aepd.es](https://www.aepd.es); C/ Jorge Juan, 6, 28001 Madrid).
7. Minors
Our forms are only for people over 18. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.
8. Security
We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.
9. Automated decisions
We do not take decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects on you. The online valuator offers an indicative value and does not replace a professional valuation.
10. Changes to this policy
If we change this policy, we will publish the new version here with its date. If the change affects the purposes for which you gave us your consent, we will ask for it again.
